paragraphs: Permitify, Inc. does business as Pangea AI, the name the product carries throughout the site. The page addresses land developers, engineers and architects, and the product is described as an AI notetaker that thinks in projects. Connected project folders in Drive, OneDrive, Egnyte or Box are mapped to the jobs a firm has going, so meeting notes file to the job they belong to.

Recording runs through a silent desktop app, a phone on the table for site walks and conference rooms, or a bot sent to Zoom, Meet or Teams. Minutes, tasks, deadlines and decisions file to the project they concern, and answers about a project cite the meeting or email they came from. Shared minutes go out as view-only links, and email and document connections are described as optional and admin controlled.

Pricing is stated as one flat price for a whole firm rather than per seat, with a free trial of two weeks and no card collected. Setup is described as done for the customer, with projects imported, storage and email connected, and the firm's minutes format built in.

quote.text: Pangea is the AI notetaker that thinks in projects, not meetings.
